title: HiFi 4x6 Speaker Adapter Frames for Porsche 911 993

rights.attribution: GarageFab (credited in the owner notes); original Thingiverse thing 6901857; Renn 3D Parts

notes: Two STL files. The archive reports a 2152.040 x 1437.940 x 253.976 mm envelope, implausible for a 4x6 speaker frame and signalling an unresolved unit or scale problem. Original Thingiverse thing 6901857 must be checked before import. 2026-10-15: the Renn 3D Parts page was re-read. It shows the licence 'Public Domain', credits the owner notes to GarageFab, links the original https://thingiverse.com/thing:6901857, lists two files (993-speaker-grill-left.stl and 993-speaker-grill-right.stl) and repeats the 2152.040 x 1437.940 x 253.976 mm envelope with a volume of 196,105,749.272 mm3; the owner notes give no dimension or unit beyond the 4x6 speaker designation. On 2026-10-15 the original Thingiverse page (thing 6901857) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. No Internet Archive capture of that page is indexed. The public-domain statement therefore rests only on this secondary archive, and redistribution is set to unknown until the licence is read on the original page. Because the licence is not confirmed, no mesh was downloaded and the bounding box was not recomputed. Dividing the archive envelope by 10 would give 215.2 x 143.8 x 25.4 mm, the right order of magnitude for a frame around a 4x6 in (about 152 x 102 mm) speaker, but that is an unverified hypothesis, not an established unit. Scale unresolved; excluded from use until checked.
